title: Recorded UK imports: bananas (HS 0803)

retrieval.notes: CN8 codes: 08030011, 08030019, 08030090, 08031010, 08031090, 08039010, 08039011, 08039019, 08039090. Import flows 1 (EU) and 3 (non-EU) summed.
